name: login-happy-path
description: User logs in with valid credentials and is redirected to the home page

doc_metadata.title: Clear Session
doc_metadata.caption: Clear browser cookies and local storage to ensure a clean test state.

doc_metadata.title: Login Page
doc_metadata.caption: Open the EAM application in your web browser. You will be presented with the login screen showing the organization branding and credential fields.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the full login page with branding. This is the first screen a user sees.

doc_metadata.title: Enter Username
doc_metadata.caption: Enter your username in the Username field. This is the account name provided by your system administrator.

doc_metadata.title: Enter Password
doc_metadata.caption: Enter your password in the Password field. Passwords are case-sensitive.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Do not reveal actual passwords in the manual. Use placeholder text.

doc_metadata.title: Submit Login
doc_metadata.caption: Click the 'Sign in' button. Upon successful authentication, you will be redirected to the home page.

doc_metadata.title: Home Page After Login
doc_metadata.caption: After successful login, the main application loads with the sidebar navigation showing all available modules.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: This screenshot shows the default landing page with sidebar navigation.
